Package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io.hid

package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io.hid
USB HID mouse control: Mouse, backed by the Arduino Mouse library.

Requires a board with native USB (the UNO R4 WiFi) and the Mouse library installed (see docs/HID.md in the project documentation). Once a program calls Mouse.begin(), it takes control of the pointer on whatever computer the board's USB port is plugged into, so uploading such a sketch needs a known way to recover (disconnect the board, or use its reset/bootloader sequence).
